It is a reminder to seek guidance from God, as knowledge and wisdom come from Him. historical_references.reference: Ibn Battuta's Travels - Ibn Battuta visited the town of Mosedi in 1331 CE during his travels in West Africa. He described it as an important commercial center and a major stop for caravans travelling between the Niger River and the Atlantic Ocean.

Al-Bakri's Book of Routes and Provinces - Al-Bakri, a Moroccan geographer and traveler, mentioned Mosedi in the 11th century CE as a town located in the region of the Senegal River. He described it as an important agricultural center with a considerable population.
